item.title: [phishing] Phishers sneak through using GitHub and Jira’s own mail delivery infrastructure
item.description: <p>Attackers are abusing the notification systems of SaaS platforms like GitHub and Jira to send phishing and spam emails, Cisco Talos researchers are warning. &#8220;Because the emails are dispatched from the platform&#8217;s own infrastructure, they satisfy all standard authentication requirements (SPF, DKIM, and DMARC), effectively neutralizing the primary gatekeepers of modern email security,&#8221; they note. &#8220;By decoupling the malicious intent from the technical infrastructure, attackers successfully deliver phishing content with a &#8216;seal of approval&#8217; that &#8230; <a href="https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/04/09/saas-platforms-notification-systems-phishing/" rel="nofollow">More <span class="meta-nav">&#8594;</span></a></p> <p>The post <a href="https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/04/09/saas-platforms-notification-systems-phishing/">Phishers sneak through using GitHub and Jira’s own mail delivery infrastructure</a> appeared first on <a href="https://www.helpnetsecurity.com">Help Net Security</a>.</p>
